about: A simple wiki built on Markdown and git.

prs.title: Renaming a page also fixes links to its subpages
prs.broken: Renaming a page moves its subpages along, but wiki links to those subpages kept the old path and pointed at pages that no longer existed.
prs.changed: I made the rename update links to subpages too, as it already did for normal Markdown links.
prs.matters: Reorganizing a wiki no longer leaves a trail of broken links.
